correctness.rationale: Pinned RESULT.md proves all width-two syndromes equal zero, any single column, or a neighboring XOR. Noncyclic telescoping and cyclic repeat-parity force at least one missing nonzero even syndrome in every ordering. Primitive field-power order 0,1,alpha,...,alpha^(Q-2) realizes exactly Q-2 adjacent differences and omits u=1+alpha^(-1), which a nonadjacent two-apart pair realizes inside width-three, for every degree m>=2. Independent GF(4) computation found seven width-two syndromes and all eight width-three syndromes, cyclic and noncyclic. Finite check does not prove all degrees.
